create.name: Dr. Clare Johnson
create.bio:
Dr. Clare Johnson is an English writer and teacher of lucid dreaming, the practice of becoming aware that you are dreaming while the dream is still going on. A vivid lucid dreamer since childhood, she studied the subject as an undergraduate at Lancaster and went on to complete a doctorate at the University of Leeds on how lucid dreams feed the creative process. She later served as president of the IASD, the main international body for dream research. Her eight books cover dreaming, sleep and nightmares, among them Llewellyn's Complete Book of Lucid Dreaming and The Art of Lucid Dreaming, as well as two novels as Clare Jay.

Her approach, which she calls Lucid Dreamplay, gathers many techniques for becoming and staying lucid, meeting dream figures, exploring the dream body and using the hypnagogic state between waking and sleep, alongside Lucid Writing, a waking practice for working creatively with dream images. A trained yoga teacher, she weaves breath and bodywork into her sleep practices. She teaches through recorded video courses with guided meditations, small residential ocean retreats in Portugal and on Hawaii's Big Island, and one-to-one mentoring, and she hosts the Sleep and Deep Lucid Dreaming podcast, where she talks with other researchers about dreams, consciousness and the threshold of death.

courses.title: Lucid Dreaming Ocean Retreat, Portugal 2027
courses.description: A four-and-a-half-day residential retreat in Carvoeiro on the Algarve coast, with daily lucidity workshops at a villa, on a yoga platform and on the beach. Places are secured with a deposit, and the group is kept small.

courses.title: The Power of Dreams: 30-Day Class
courses.description: A month of short daily video lessons on lucid awareness and the wisdom of dreams, with guided meditations to download and recorded group workshops. Taken on demand at your own pace.

courses.title: The Power of Sleep: 30-Day Class
courses.description: Thirty days of video content treating sleep as a journey through states of consciousness, with downloadable meditations and five recorded group workshops. An on-demand class for people who want to work creatively with the night.

courses.title: Dream Yoga: Conscious Sleep for Wake-Induced Lucid Dreams
courses.description: Video lessons and guided audio practices for carrying awareness from waking into sleep, for wake-induced lucid dreams and out-of-body exploration. The audios are yours to keep.

courses.title: Portals to Lucidity & Sound Healing
courses.description: Seven video lessons and six guided journeys built around the elements, sound and spirit as doorways into lucid journeying, plus two recorded live workshops. Self-paced.

courses.title: Lucid Mindset
courses.description: A short video lesson with three guided meditations: daily habits for lucidity, a dream induction, and a practice with a tiger as power animal. Downloadable.

courses.title: Manifest Your Best Dreamlife
courses.description: A video lesson and three guided meditations for remembering dreams, asking questions of them and stepping inside their images. Downloadable to keep.

free_resources.title: Sleep and Deep Lucid Dreaming Podcast
free_resources.description: Her podcast of long conversations with dream researchers and teachers on lucidity, sleep, near-death experience and consciousness. Free on the usual podcast platforms.

free_resources.title: Free Lucid Dreaming Guide and Meditations
free_resources.description: Joining her mailing list brings a short lucid dreaming guidebook, a mini video class and guided sleep meditations to keep.
